verdict.rationale: Brex is a corporate card/spend-management platform for its own business customers, not a Banking-as-a-Service provider; its APIs (Team, Payments, Transactions, Expenses) let developers manage their own Brex account programmatically, not issue embedded bank accounts to third-party end customers. This is a category mismatch — embedded banking licensing is not a plausible axis for this type of product based on the evidence.
